column1: # note: regenerated with the current binaries and pipeline-driver defaults

# note: SUPPLEMENTARY, development: the reference is a SECONDARY one (the contig's protein-homology families; the genome-wide supplement uses Ensembl Compara and Liftoff copy pairs; protein is not part of Rustle's default family definition)

# note: genes scored (plotted, metric recall = sensitivity): protein-homology genes with >= 2 reads whose PRIMARY record has an aligned block (M/=/X; not N, not D) on one of the gene's annotated exons (_o1.primary_counts; fig. 3's n_mol_primary rule): 576 of 775 genes

# note: metric recall_span_universe: the same scorer over the recorded list's rule, >= 2 primary records overlapping the gene SPAN (spliced-over reads included): 613 of 775 genes; the span rule reproduces the recorded gene list of registers 1096-1101 exactly (613 genes)
# note: rustle_primary: largest predicted family 5 genes (protein-homology families PF82:5)
# note: rustle: largest predicted family 21 genes (protein-homology families PF68:21)

# note: configuration (column arm) rustle = loci seeded with primaries + secondary alignments within 2% of the read's genome-wide best alignment score (driver default); rustle_primary = --no-seed-secondaries; both through the families stage (the default family rule)

# note: recall (sensitivity): same-family pairs whose two genes are both scored (above), banded by the best minimap2 (asm20 -k11 -w5) identity between the two genes' annotated mRNAs; 'none' = no alignment record

# note: precision: judgeable within-family gene pairs (both genes in a protein-homology family) against the COMPLETE families (score.py pairs --bands paf:; independent of the genes scored, checked); see fig6_gorilla_clusters for the judgeable / gene / locus pair counts
# note: column truth = the reference (protein-homology families of the contig); ci = Wilson 95%, which treats pairs as independent; they are not (fig6_gorilla_clusters)
